newsitem.title: UK: Sony to sign new British record label - paper. [CORRECTED 18:09 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sony to sign new British record label - paper. [CORRECTED 18:09 GMT]

text.p: Sony Music will soon complete a multi-million pound deal with British record label Independiente, a British newspaper said on Wednesday.

The Financial Times said Andy Macdonald, who set up Independiente last year after clashing with PolyGram, had held talks with a number of record companies but had agreed the basis of a deal with Sony Music.

MacDonald signed Paul Weller, The Beautiful South and Portishead to his Go! Discs label but resigned from the company last year when Polygram took full control of it. Those three top selling acts remain part of the PolyGram stable (corrects to make clear that Weller, Portishead and The Beautiful South are not signed to the Independiente label).
